page: UpCloud PREMIUM-48xCPU-256GB is a KVM-based virtual server featuring 48 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor running at 2.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The CPU configuration provides 48 physical cores with a single thread per core under a shared allocation model. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding 5.33 GB of RAM per core, and includes 500 GB of local SSD storage.

Benchmark results indicate strong compute capabilities. The server achieves top-tier performance in stress-ng single-core CPU tests and strong performance in multi-core CPU tests. Memory performance is mixed, with small-block cached read bandwidth ranking in the top 25 percent, while large-block uncached read and write bandwidths fall into the middle 50 percent. Cryptographic and vector execution capabilities are supported by hardware flags including AVX-512 and AES.

This hardware profile is well-suited for multi-threaded processing, database operations, and static web serving, where it demonstrates strong benchmark throughput. However, LLM inference benchmarks show a tradeoff: while prompt processing for small models is strong, prompt processing for medium 7B models falls into the bottom 25 percent, indicating limitations for larger AI workloads without dedicated GPU acceleration. The server represents a dense resource allocation suitable for enterprise-grade general-purpose workloads and parallel processing tasks.
description: The UpCloud PREMIUM-48xCPU-256GB is an x86_64 virtual server built on the KVM hypervisor, featuring 48 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9575F processor running at 2.0 GHz. It is configured with 256.0 GB of RAM (5.33 GB per core) and 500 GB of local SSD storage. Benchmarks show top-tier single-core CPU performance and strong multi-core performance, alongside strong database and static web serving throughput. Large-block memory bandwidth and medium-model LLM prompt processing represent performance tradeoffs, landing in the average and weak categories respectively. Lacking a dedicated GPU, this server is optimized for high-density general-purpose computing, multi-threaded applications, and database hosting.
